package.limits: Not live/physical-platform or full Photoshop parity evidence.

api.engine: Command.action/RecordedAction/ActionBatch; desktop and API share transaction/persistence paths
api.adobe: Existing published /v2/execute-actions and async resources remain separate and regression-tested. No new Adobe endpoint or .atn equivalence is claimed.

limitations: Only the typed operations in ActionOperation are recordable; other successful edits become visible blocking entries until removed/disabled. Prepared composite crop/warp/AI, external assets, many channel/context operations and some layer edits remain unsupported.
No Adobe .atn import/export, JavaScript execution, conditional/modal action steps, function-key assignment or tool-gesture recording preferences. Native format is .photatoactions v1.
Actions panel currently floats independently; dockable panel integration is deferred. Per-step parameter rerecording requires replacing recorded actions; step enable/remove/reorder is available.

Batch supports up to256 local sources; API uses up to8 already shared source documents. Folder scan is one level. No Bridge/import source, droplet, file-open/save override or automatic overwrite workflow.

Batch writes numbered copies via atomic staged output and exclusive hard-link publication; a filesystem lacking hard links reports an error. Each output is capped at128MiB. Successfully published copies remain after cancellation/error.

Native library up to128 actions/512 entries per action/16MiB; recording beyond511 steps retains a blocking limit entry. API imports are bounded to60000 base64 characters inside the existing64KiB request limit.
Offscreen layout tests and PNGs are not live interaction or visual parity evidence. Snapshot AppKit controls are incompletely rendered. The last desktop evidence was locked; no unlock re-probe.
Exact Photoshop numerical output, physical Intel/macOS14/26, full API/menu/preferences/feature equivalence and AUT01 remain open.
